name: Logto
title: logto.io
shortDescription: Logto simplifies authentication for developers by integrating multi-tenancy, enterprise SSO, and RBAC into SaaS or AI apps. It supports OIDC and OAuth 2.1, ensuring a developer-friendly approach that scales from local to cloud and web to mobile. Ideal for developers tired of rebuilding auth systems, Logto offers a token-based, pay-as-you-go model with a free tier up to 50K MAUs.
pros: Supports 20+ frameworks and clean Management API
cons: May require technical knowledge to set up and manage
Pay-as-you-go model can become expensive at scale
Limited customization options compared to bespoke solutions

aiSuggestedAlternatives.name: OneLogin
aiSuggestedAlternatives.reason: Simplifies user access with single sign-on
